boundary-tiny.notes: Tiny local baseline. Must pass boundary regression tests before trusting applied joins. Uses text only, no OCR.

boundary-small.notes: Larger small-model candidate; compare false joins against boundary-tiny. No model downloaded at import time.

glm-ocr.notes: Official benchmark pipeline adds PP-DocLayoutV3 and region recognition. This adapter does not reproduce it.

ovisocr3.notes: Locally executed on M3 Max with MLX 0.7.10 and original BF16 weights, official document-Markdown prompt, Archive.org PDF 9-10. Drops the page-final hyphen in this sample. Other tasks untested.

paddle-vl.notes: Locally executed: PP-DocLayoutV3 Torch CPU layout + PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 BF16 MLX region OCR; rectangle crops and simple reading-order assembly. Batch-axis compatibility shim required. Tested Archive.org PDF 9-10; not exact PaddleX benchmark parity.

lighton-3-08b.notes: Qwen3.5 architecture. MLX execution is experimental until smoke-tested. Grounding markers are retained in raw output.

lighton-3-4b.notes: Nominal model size differs from serialized total including vision. Runtime support must be checked.

teleocr.notes: Locally executed using Apache-2.0 teleocr-rs 0.2.0, Q8 text/vision GGUF and a recorded Metal device-selection fix. Full layout/crop pipeline tested on Archive.org PDF 9-10. Text/table reference examples match. Port has figure/title/LaTeX limitations.

mineru-pro.license: Apache-2.0 declared for weights; application has additional terms
mineru-pro.notes: Use mineru-vl-utils/full pipeline through command protocol after license review. Model-only inference does not reproduce coarse-to-fine parsing.

dots-mocr.notes: Use official task prompts and postprocessing in an external runner; generic OCR prompt deliberately not invented.

xiaomi-ocr.notes: Official parsing is layout-first; use command protocol for a faithful implementation.
